title: In-Situ Investigation of Notifications in Multi-Device Environments

scope_decision.qualification: The paper analyzes Android screen/status/touch observations with ESM response data. It does not collect naturally arriving notification callbacks or construct same-package app sessions. Windows PC logs and the dedicated ESM phone are separate source branches.

existing_corpus_overlap: Exact DOI exists in normalized combined study-method extractions; C21 mixes collector, ESM and study-window facts, while C09/C18 app-package constructs are not applicable. This isolated draft does not mutate the frozen review queue or canonical 94-audit set.
source_method_variants: Android phone, tablet and smartwatch share an event-based logger; the Windows PC has a distinct idle/login/foreground-process logger. Do not force a common raw event schema across platforms.

The additional Android ESM handset produces study questionnaires and their own prompt notifications, not inbound third-party alerts. The four target-device ratings are separate per-device answers to one prompt, not four collector variants.

One-touch-per-minute Android retention is a collector-time event cap; the once-per-minute Windows inactivity check is a separate polling cadence; 45–90-minute ESM triggering and 10-minute prompt expiry are different clocks.

analysis_outputs_and_population_warnings: This is a study of desired notification device, not one of actual inbound notification arrival, dismissal or response. ESM prompt notifications are study interventions.
The one-touch-per-minute cap is source collection loss; no subsequent algorithm can recover discarded touches. Its selection within each minute is not stated.
Android screen-on duration and Windows login-to-logout minus idle represent different active-time definitions. Do not pool these under one unqualified session constructor.
The ESM screen-event adjacency window and event-to-answer alignment are unspecified; neither the ten-minute prompt expiry nor 45–90-minute schedule supplies that missing value.
C09 same-package runs and C18 package policy in the normalized 21-row rubric are inapplicable, not missing source settings for this paper.
